en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4460 - Ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Jamil ibn Darraj, who reported from Abu Abdullah (as) regarding a man who married two sisters in a single contract.
Imam (as) said: "He should keep whichever one he wishes and release the other."

And regarding a man who married five women in a single contract.
Imam (as) said: "He should release whichever ones he wishes."
